Spider-Man Film Surpasses Avatar 2 in Box Office Rankings

Spider-Man: Brand New Day has become the third highest-grossing film of all time, surpassing Avatar: The Way of Water. The film has grossed $2.33 billion globally. Meanwhile, Coyote vs. Acme debuted with an estimated $15.5 million in its opening weekend, following Warner Bros.' decision to cancel the film for a tax write-off before its eventual release. Spider-Man: Brand New Day has now held the top box office spot for five consecutive weekends.
